audit_items.proof_trace: The invariant holds by construction: total seized = (1 + liquidation_incentive) × repay_value; protocol gets fee_rate × total_seized; liquidator gets (1 - fee_rate) × total_seized - repay_value. Summing liquidator net gain and protocol share yields (1 + incentive) × repay_value - repay_value = incentive × repay_value = penalty exactly. The integer subtraction at reserve.move:176 (`liquidator_seize_amount = redeem_collateral_amount - protocol_seize_amount`) guarantees no rounding leakage.
